title: Palindrome Partitioning
statement:
Partition `s` into contiguous pieces so every piece is a palindrome. Return all valid partitions, ordered lexicographically by their lists of pieces.

## Examples

```text
Input: s = "aab"
Output: [["a","a","b"],["aa","b"]]
```

```text
Input: s = "a"
Output: [["a"]]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= s.length <= 16`
- `s` contains lowercase English letters
